text:
Alex Rivera
Software Engineer, AI and LLM applications
Auckland, New Zealand
021 555 0142 | alex.rivera@inspectcopilot.com
SUMMARY
Software engineer with four years of TypeScript and Python, the last two shipping LLM features to production. I
turn messy business text into structured, checked data, and I make model behaviour visible with tracing and
evaluation sets so teams can trust it.
EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Humongous Insurance Auckland | Feb 2023 to present
- Built a claims-intake assistant: an LLM reads customer emails and PDFs, its output is validated against JSON
schemas, and over 2,000 claims a month are routed without manual triage.
- Built a 300-claim evaluation set and step-by-step tracing, which cut misrouted claims from 9% to 3%.
- Moved four Node.js services to AWS Lambda with GitHub Actions deployments.
- Mentor two graduate developers.
Junior Full Stack Developer, Margie's Travel Wellington | Jan 2021 to Jan 2023
- Built booking and itinerary features in React, Next.js and PostgreSQL.
- Wrote Python tooling that reconciles supplier invoices against bookings, saving the finance team a day a month.
- Added Vitest and Playwright tests to a codebase that had none.
PROJECTS
- Recipe planner (side project): retrieval over 5,000 recipes with Next.js, PostgreSQL and pgvector, with an LLM
that explains each suggestion.
SKILLS
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL
- AI: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek), tool calling, structured outputs, JSON Schema and Zod, retrieval
(pgvector), evaluation sets, tracing
- Web: Node.js, Next.js, React, REST
- Data and cloud: PostgreSQL, SQLite, AWS Lambda and S3, Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Actions
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Computer Science, Te Awa University, 2020
